confidence_semantics: publisher/source authority only; not parcel numeric accuracy

candidates.publisher: HM Land Registry / National Data Library
candidates.name: INSPIRE Index Polygons spatial data - National Data Library
verified_facts: The official catalogue record was last updated 8 July 2026.
INSPIRE Index Polygons contain locations of freehold registered property in England and Wales as a subset of the Index Polygons database.
Files are divided by local authority and a polygon crossing a local-authority boundary can appear in both files.
semantic_limits: Duplicate appearance across local-authority files must be de-duplicated by identity before QA counts.
INSPIRE polygons remain indicative property-location geometry, not exact legal boundary or terrain measurement evidence.

candidates.name: Use land and property data - dataset catalogue
verified_facts: The service lists INSPIRE Index Polygons as free, monthly, Open Government Licence data.
The same service lists National Polygon Service as a paid product, while INSPIRE remains the auth-light free polygon route for this workflow.
semantic_limits: Paid/account-dependent National Polygon Service must not become a required dependency for AAYS.
Free INSPIRE geometry remains indicative and cannot substitute for a determined legal boundary.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Downloading Survey Data
verified_facts: National LIDAR Programme and LIDAR Composite raster products are supplied as GeoTIFF in 5km tiles.
LIDAR point-cloud data is supplied as LAZ, the compressed form of LAS.
Available downloads are organised by product, year and resolution.
semantic_limits: File format and tile packaging are delivery semantics, not independent measurement evidence.
Any account-dependent convenience workflow is optional; this slot must not require user registration or paid access.

candidates.name: National LIDAR Programme - National Data Library mirror
verified_facts: The official catalogue mirror describes 1m elevation coverage for all England.
Phase 1 used 302 survey blocks captured during winter campaigns from January 2017 to February 2023.
Repeat blocks use incrementing phase numbers and repeats are requirement-driven rather than a guaranteed rolling national recapture.
semantic_limits: Catalogue metadata does not identify the exact contributing survey for a parcel.
The environment.data.gov.uk survey/index metadata remains the operational lineage authority.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite DTM 1m - National Data Library mirror
verified_facts: The official mirror describes approximately 99% England coverage at 1m spatial resolution.
The 2022 composite combines Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys.
Repeat coverage uses newest best-resolution data and resampled inputs use bilinear interpolation.
semantic_limits: This mirror is a catalogue cross-check, not a second independent elevation observation.
Parcel-specific survey identity still requires the exact EA metadata-index feature match.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 product page
verified_facts: OS describes Terrain 50 as a low-resolution DTM produced from photogrammetry with 50m post spacing and 10m contours.
The product is updated annually and is free to use for everyone.
It is intended for broad applications over large areas.
semantic_limits: Terrain 50 remains a coarse secondary cross-check and must not replace EA DTM1m parcel sampling.
Open/free access does not imply parcel-scale accuracy.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 product page
verified_facts: OS describes Terrain 5 as a mid-resolution DTM at 5m post spacing and 5m contours produced from photogrammetry.
The product is updated every three months.
OS describes a typical accuracy level greater than 2m RMSE and provides free sample data.
semantic_limits: Terrain 5 product-level RMSE is not parcel-specific uncertainty.
Terrain 5 remains secondary to Environment Agency DTM1m for this slot.
